title: The Corden
description: Turns the warden into non-oscar winning actor James Corden
body:
This resource pack turns the warden into non-oscar winning actor James Corden. It started as a joke between me and some friends that grew into this, and now I want it here on Modrinth for all to witness and despair.

I got the maid outfit texture from somewhere on Planet Minecraft years ago, and the Corden face on Google Images somewhere (sorry it was so long ago).
